audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t and report[9].t misgender Lulu as "his/His" (Lulu is she/her), and breakdown.cooldowns has no real cooldown number or the fact that Whimsy isn't magic CC.
audit.why: Gender per champ-data/champ-gender.js. Whimsy (W) is an 18s flat cooldown that silences/disarms — it is not magic CC, so Black Shield cannot block it.
audit.corrected: Both pronoun fields fixed; breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with the real cooldown and the Black Shield caveat.

audit.why: Chart (Lulu favored 1-3, Morgana favored 4-first item, Lulu favored again late) matches the content-layer's explanation of poke early, all-in window mid, then Wild Growth/polymorph peel scaling late.
Level 6 and first-item spikes are already correctly grounded in Soul Shackles vs Whimsy/shield timing.

edits.before: - Lulu Whimsy (Polymorph): matchup-defining — The polymorph deletes a carry’s kit mid-fight — bait it before the real engage. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Black Shield answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: Whimsy (W) polymorphs on an 18s flat cooldown — it silences and disarms the target, so Black Shield can't stop it since it isn't magic CC. Bait the cast on a minion or ward, then commit while it's down; your own Q is meanwhile down 10s if you miss.

edits.before: W the pair, bank the Q visibly, shield the answer — the threat governs while the pool bills.
edits.after: Q the carry the instant Whimsy is spent — 18s is a long window to punish before it resets.
